label: Install deferred lifecycle coherence and insert-time audit guards

precheck.description: fail closed when existing routes have duplicate active reservations
precheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public."driverReservation"
  WHERE "releasedAt" IS NULL
  GROUP BY "routeId" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) AS result

precheck.description: fail closed when existing routes have duplicate reconciliation audits
precheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public."legacyRouteReconciliation"
  GROUP BY "routeId" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) AS result

precheck.description: ensure these coherence functions are not already installed

execute.description: install row-locked route, visit, claim, and hold consistency checks

postcheck.description: verify all twelve coherence triggers exist and are enabled
postcheck.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) = 12 AS result FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgenabled = 'O' AND tgname IN (
              't1e_delivery_attempt_capture',
              't1e_order_claim_history',
              't1e_driver_reservation_history',
              't1e_reconciliation_admin',
              't1e_route_coherence',
              't1e_stop_coherence',
              't1e_claim_coherence',
              't1e_reservation_coherence',
              't1e_reconciliation_coherence',
              't1e_order_route_pointer_coherence',
              't1e_attempt_coherence',
              't1e_reservation_legacy_release_audit'
            )

precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3))) AS "result"

execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."deliveryAttempt" ADD CONSTRAINT "delivery_attempt_failure_reason_pairing_2c593598" CHECK ((outcome = 'FAILED' AND "failureReason" IS NOT NULL) OR (outcome = 'SUCCESSFUL' AND "failureReason" IS NULL))

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3))) AS "result"

execute.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "one_active_reservation_per_route_b3e558e7" ON "public"."driverReservation" ("routeId") WHERE (("releasedAt" IS NULL))
